title: Missing letter “h”
text: Missing letter “h”. Aside from having to string this all together yourself, the glitter presentation is really, really pretty. That being said, I received this a day late (on the celebration day, minutes before it started) and it was missing an “h”, so I had to go with hearts and “happy anniversary” and leave out “40th” which was kind of the point of this banner to begin with. Oh well, at least it was usable.
